leads.name: Metrosideros at Campo de Sao Francisco
leads.reason: OSM node 3106113528 named Metrosidero in the square; komoot says planted over 150 years ago, branches held by steel props; a Tripadvisor summary gave 7.6 m girth, 18 m height but the page would not fetch. No official source read. Needs a register or council source for age and size.

leads.name: Dragoeiro, Rua Coronel Silva Leal
leads.reason: OSM node 13162961526 only; lifecheck NONE; no source for age or access (street or private plot not known).

leads.name: Norfolk Island pine, Rua Antonio Borges
leads.reason: OSM node 12025325543 next to Jardim Antonio Borges; SIARAM names a majestic Norfolk pine near the small lake inside the garden, not confirmed as the same trunk.

leads.name: Ficus macrophylla inside Jardim Jose do Canto
leads.reason: OSM nodes 12020707815 and 12020707823; inventory says monumental Ficus, Agathis and Araucaria bidwillii there (europeangardens.eu summary only, PDF would not fetch). Needs the SIARAM tree list and the garden's entry terms.

leads.name: Jardim Duque da Terceira araucarias, Angra do Heroismo (Terceira)
leads.reason: Municipal guide and SIARAM say centenary araucarias from the 1882 opening; no individual tree, age or coordinate found. Terceira is about 40 minutes by plane from Sao Miguel.

notes: No individual-tree register for the Azores found: DRRF's RRAIPA was created by DRR 2/2026/A (6 March 2026) and its list was not reachable (drrf.azores.gov.pt 403 to WebFetch); a 2022 news item cited 58 classified trees, 37 Faial, 14 Terceira, 7 Sao Miguel, not seen.
